subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 06, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - November 06, 2026**

**Critical Security Vulnerability Affects OpenSSH on Alpine Linux Systems**

We have an important update regarding a critical security vulnerability that affects OpenSSH on Alpine Linux systems. Version 10.6p2 of OpenSSH has been released with a workaround for this vulnerability. We urge all users to update their systems as soon as possible to ensure the security of their data. For more information, please refer to the official OpenSSH release notes.

**Community News**

The AcreetionOS community has been actively working on various projects, including updates to Calamares, our universal Linux installer. Our community members have been busy fixing issues and improving the user experience. We're grateful for their dedication and hard work.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that you can easily update your AcreetionOS system using the `sudo pacman -Syu` command? This command will update your system to the latest version, ensuring you have the latest security patches and features. Simply open a terminal and type the command to get started.

That's all for this week's newsletter. Stay safe and keep exploring the world of AcreetionOS!
